verdict.rationale: Snyk provides a documented Snyk Studio/MCP server and hooks-based integration explicitly designed to scan AI-agent-generated code at inception ('secure at inception'), plus slash commands like /snyk-fix and /snyk-batch-fix and a natural-language prompt workflow to trigger scans directly inside coding agents/ADEs. This is first-party documented, concrete, and specific to AI-native workflows; missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the MCP/agent integration specifically (community evidence covers general Snyk product sentiment, not this agent-wiring feature).
